fromEntity.name: Saga tutoring: Chicago trial estimates (Guryan et al., 2023)
fromEntity.description: Academic, attendance, disciplinary and arrest estimates from two randomized Chicago tutoring trials. Each estimate retains its study, uncertainty and source context.

fromEntity.name: Education Initiatives glossary
fromEntity.description: Definitions of education research designs, inputs, outcomes and evidence terms. This collection is being migrated from Education Initiatives.

fromEntity.name: Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS)
fromEntity.description: IPEDS provides annual institution- and cohort-level postsecondary education data. It supplies pathway and completion context; it does not establish that an initiative caused an outcome.

fromEntity.name: Urban Institute Education Data Portal
fromEntity.description: Urban Institute Education Data Portal provides programmatic access to selected public education data. It supplies delivery and field-shape context; it does not establish that an initiative caused an outcome.

fromEntity.name: Teacher coaching: pooled instruction and achievement effects (Kraft et al., 2018)
fromEntity.description: Pooled teacher-coaching effects on instructional practice and student achievement from a synthesis of causal studies. Subject and coaching-model subgroups overlap with the overall estimates.

fromEntity.name: STAR class sizes and classroom aides: experimental results (Krueger, 1999)
fromEntity.description: Measured achievement effects from Tennessee’s randomized class-size experiment, organized by grade and assigned classroom condition. Effects are percentile points, with standard errors and source citations.

fromEntity.name: Civil Rights Data Collection (CRDC)
fromEntity.description: CRDC provides collection-cycle data on civil-rights conditions in U.S. public schools and districts. It supplies equity and implementation context; it does not establish that an initiative caused an outcome.

fromEntity.name: Annual Survey of School System Finances (F-33)
fromEntity.description: F-33 provides annual district- and state-level public school finance data. It supplies cost and resource context; it does not establish that an initiative caused an outcome.

fromEntity.name: High School Longitudinal Study of 2009 (HSLS:09)
fromEntity.description: A nationally representative study follows students who were ninth-graders in fall 2009 into postsecondary education. Its observational data support analysis of educational pathways; causal effects require a separate credible study design.

fromEntity.name: Third Grade Follow-up to the Head Start Impact Study (HSIS), United States, 2007-2008
fromEntity.description: ICPSR’s archive for the Head Start third-grade follow-up. Documentation is public; some analytic data files require a restricted-data agreement to protect respondent privacy.

fromEntity.name: National Teacher and Principal Survey (NTPS) and Teacher Follow-up Survey (TFS)
fromEntity.description: NTPS and TFS provide nationally representative teacher and school workforce context. They do not identify effects of a local initiative without a separate credible design.

fromEntity.name: Education Resources Information Center (ERIC)
fromEntity.description: ERIC indexes education research records and links to available full text. It supports source discovery and verification; it does not establish that an initiative caused an outcome.

fromEntity.name: School-finance reforms: spending and adult outcomes (Jackson, Johnson and Persico, 2016)
fromEntity.description: Estimates of how reform-induced school spending relates to educational attainment and adult economic outcomes. Results distinguish childhood-income groups and preserve the reported regression scale.

fromEntity.name: ABC/CARE: early-childhood outcomes and modeled economic returns
fromEntity.description: Evidence from the related ABC and CARE early-childhood experiments. Observed findings and modeled economic estimates retain their separate source versions and assumptions.

fromEntity.name: Common Core of Data (CCD) Public School and LEA Universe
fromEntity.description: NCES’s annual public directory of U.S. public schools and local education agencies. It supplies identifiers and descriptive context; it does not estimate program effects.

fromEntity.name: Perry Preschool: costs, observed outcomes and modeled returns
fromEntity.description: Study evidence from a preschool intervention in Ypsilanti, Michigan. Costs, descriptive outcomes and modeled economic returns retain their distinct assumptions and source context.

fromEntity.name: NAEP Data Explorer
fromEntity.description: NAEP Data Explorer provides representative assessment results across national, state, and participating urban-district samples. It supplies benchmark and trend context; it does not establish that an initiative caused an outcome.

fromEntity.name: Stanford Education Data Archive (SEDA), Version 6.0
fromEntity.description: SEDA provides harmonized U.S. achievement, growth, gap, and contextual data across education geographies. It is comparative context data, not evidence that an initiative caused an outcome.

fromEntity.name: Early Childhood Longitudinal Study, Kindergarten Class of 2010-11 (ECLS-K:2011)
fromEntity.description: ECLS-K:2011 follows a nationally representative kindergarten cohort from 2010 through fifth grade. It supports weighted descriptive and developmental context; it does not by itself estimate an initiative’s effect.

fromEntity.name: Education Initiatives questions
fromEntity.description: Questions about education policy and practice from the Education Initiatives collection. Each pairs an open question with its original debate framing.

fromEntity.name: College Scorecard
fromEntity.description: College Scorecard provides institution- and cohort-level postsecondary completion, earnings, debt, repayment, and aid data. It supplies pathway and return context; it does not establish that an initiative caused an outcome.

fromEntity.name: Head Start: randomized-access impacts through third grade
fromEntity.description: Findings from the national randomized Head Start access study and its follow-up through third grade. Entry-age cohorts, reporters and ITT versus participation-adjusted estimates remain distinct.

fromEntity.name: Reading First: achievement and implementation impacts (Gamse et al., 2008)
fromEntity.description: Estimated effects of a US early-reading grant program on achievement, classroom instruction and implementation. Results distinguish measured learning outcomes from observed practices and self-reported delivery.

fromEntity.name: STAR class-size economics: modeled costs and earnings (Krueger, 2003)
fromEntity.description: Modeled costs and projected earnings for reducing early-grade class sizes, based on Tennessee STAR evidence. Compare economic assumptions and sensitivity scenarios in 1998 US dollars.

fromEntity.name: School Survey on Crime and Safety (SSOCS)
fromEntity.description: A nationally representative cross-sectional survey describes crime and safety in U.S. public schools. It provides school-safety context rather than longitudinal estimates of program effects.

fromEntity.name: EDFacts / Ed Data Express
fromEntity.description: EDFacts provides annual school-, district-, and state-level education data with subgroup detail. It supplies outcome and accountability context; it does not establish an initiative effect.

fromEntity.name: What Works Clearinghouse
fromEntity.description: An Institute of Education Sciences resource reviews education research and summarizes findings about interventions and practices. Read its assessments alongside the underlying primary studies.
